replace_credentials.title: U-Tec credentials
replace_credentials.description: Enter your Client ID and Client Secret from the Xthings app (My Account → OpenAPI). Submitting will start the U-Tec authorization. The Client Secret is never displayed back — re-enter it here even if you are only rotating the secret.

error.empty_credentials: Both Client ID and Client Secret are required.

update_push.title: Configure Uhome
update_push.description: Enable or disable push notifications for device updates

push_device_selection.title: Select Devices for Push Updates
push_device_selection.description: Choose which devices should receive push updates. If none are selected, all devices will receive updates.

device_selection.title: Select Active Devices
device_selection.description: Choose which devices should be active in HomeAssistant.

optimistic_updates.title: Optimistic Updates
optimistic_updates.description: Pick how each device type should reflect commands. 'All' writes optimistic state for every device of that type, 'None' waits for confirmed state, 'Custom' lets you pick specific devices.

pick_lights.title: Optimistic Lights
pick_lights.description: Select the light devices that should use optimistic updates. Unselected lights will wait for confirmed state.

pick_switches.title: Optimistic Switches
pick_switches.description: Select the switch devices that should use optimistic updates. Unselected switches will wait for confirmed state.

pick_locks.title: Optimistic Locks
pick_locks.description: Select the lock devices that should use optimistic updates. Unselected locks will wait for confirmed state.

polling_interval.title: Polling Interval
polling_interval.description: How often Home Assistant should poll the U-Tec API for device state. 20 seconds is the recommended lock interval when Adaptive Aggressive is on: slow enough to be kind to the API, and still long enough for the full 1/2/3/5/8 confirmation sequence. With reliable push you can raise this further (300–600 seconds). The default of 10 seconds suits installs that rely mainly on polling.

adaptive_aggressive.title: Adaptive Aggressive
adaptive_aggressive.description: After a lock or unlock command, poll only that lock on a Fibonacci delay (1s, 2s, 3s, 5s, 8s) until the API reports the commanded state. Recommended on. U-Tec push often never arrives, and this burst stops at 5 attempts or when the next delay would be at least the idle poll interval. Passage mode is skipped.

pick_adaptive_locks.title: Adaptive Aggressive Locks
pick_adaptive_locks.description: Select the locks that should get a confirmation burst after a command. Unselected locks wait for the idle poll or a push.
